spans.s:
लोम at the end of comps. = लोमन्; (अम्), n.
a hairy tail, tail.

लोमन् लोमन्, अ, n. (a later form of रोमन्,
q. v.), the hair on the body of men and animals,
(especially) short hair, wool, down, feathers, nap, &c.,
(not so properly applicable to the hair of the head
and beard nor to the mane and tail of animals); a
tail (according to some).
—लोम-करणी, f. a species
of plant (= मांस-च्छदा).
—लोम-कर्ण, अस्, m.
‘hair-eared,’ a hare.
—लोम-कीट, अस्, m. ‘hair-
insect, ‘a louse.
—लोम-कूप or लोम-गर्त, अस्,
m. ‘hair-hole,’ a pore of the skin.
—लोम-घ्न,
अम्, n. ‘hair-destruction,’ loss of the hair through
disease, morbid baldness.
—लोम-पाद, अस्, m., N.
of a king of the Aṅgas.
—लोमपाद-पुरी, f.
Champā, the capital of Loma-pāda (the modern
Bhāgalpur and its vicinity).
—लोम-प्रवाहिन्, ई,
इणी or इनी, इ, = लोम-वाहिन्.
—लोम-फल, अम्,
n. the fruit of Dillenia Indica.
—लोम-मणि, इस्, m.
an amulet made of hair.
—लोम-यूक, अस्, m. a
hair-louse.
—लोम-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, = रोम-वत्,
having hair, hairy.
—लोम-वाहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, bearing
or carrying hair, having feathers, feathered (said of an
arrow); = रोम-वाहिन्, sharp enough to cut a hair.
—लोम-विवर, अम्, n. = रोम-विवर, ‘hair-
hole, ‘a pore of the skin.
—लोम-विष, अस्, आ, अम्,
having poisonous hair, whose hair is poisonous (said
of tigers and other animals).
—लोम-वेताल, अस्, m.
epithet of a particular demon.
—लोम-शातन, अम्,
n. an application for removing the hair of the body,
a depilatory.
—लोम-संहर्षण, अस्, आ, अम्,
causing the hair of the body to bristle, producing
horripilation.
—लोम-सातन, incorrect for लोम-श्˚.
—लोम-सार, अस्, m. an emerald.
—लोम-हर्ष,
अस्, m. the bristling or erection of the hair of the
body, thrill or shudder (caused by excessive joy, fear,
&c.), horripilation [cf. रोम-हर्ष]; N. of a
Rākṣasa.
—लोम-हर्षण, अस्, आ, अम्, causing
bristling or erection of the hair of the body, pro-
ducing horripilation, causing a shudder, exciting
horror, exciting a thrill of joy, thrilling; (अस्), m.,
N. of Sūta (the pupil of Vyāsa and father of Sauti,
who repeated the Mahā-bhārata to the Ṛṣis, cf.
रोम-हर्षण); (अम्), n. the bristling of the
hair of the body, horripilation, thrilling with delight,
shuddering with horror.
—लोम-हर्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ,
= लोम-हर्षण.
—लोम-हारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, = लो-
म-वाहिन्.
—लोम-हृत्, त्, त्, त्, removing the hair
of the body, depilatory; (त्), m. yellow orpiment.
—लोमाञ्च (˚म-अञ्˚), अस्, m. curling or erection
of the hair of the body, a thrill of rapture, shudder,
&c., = रोमाञ्च.
—लोमालिका (˚म-आल्˚), f. a fox (?).
[]
—लोमावलि (˚म-आव्˚), इस्, f. the line of hair from
the breast to the navel.

लोमक = लोमन् in प्रति-ल्˚, मृदु-ल्˚, (अ-लो-
मक, having no hair, hairless.)
लोमकागृह, अम्, n. a proper N.
लोमधि, इस्, m., N. of a king.

लोमश, अस्, आ, अम्, hairy, woolly, downy, shaggy,
bristly, covered with hair &c., made of hair, mixed
with hair; containing hair; consisting in sheep or
other woolly animals (as property &c.); woollen;
overgrown with grass &c.; (अस्), m. a ram, sheep;
N. of a Ṛṣi; of a cat (in Mahā-bh. Śānti-p. 4934);
(आ), f. a fox; a female jackal (= शृगाली); an ape;
green vitriol; N. of various plants, Nardostachys
Jatamansi; Leea Hirta; Carpopogon Pruriens; Sida
Cordifolia; Sida Rhombifolia; orris root (= वचा);
Cucumis Utilissimus; = गन्ध-मांसी; = शण-
पुष्पी; N. of a Śākinī or female divinity of an
inferior class; an attendant on Durgā; (अम्), n. a
kind of metre.
—लोमश-कर्ण, अस्, m. a species
of animal living in holes.
—लोमश-काण्डा, f. Cu-
cumis Utilissimus.
—लोमश-पर्णिनी, f. Glycine
Debilis.
—लोमश-पुष्पक, अस्, m. Acacia Sirissa.
—लोमश-मार्जार, अस्, m. the civet cat.
—लो-
मश-वक्षण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. covered with hair
on the breast or body.
—लोमश-सक्थ, अस्, आ,
अम्, or लोमश-सक्थि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. having hair
or bristles on the thighs or hind feet; (according to
Mahī-dhara on Vājasaneyi-s. 24, 1 = बहु-रोम-
पुच्छिक), having a hairy tail.

लोमाश, अस्, m. a jackal or fox; [cf. लोमशा,
लोपाश.]

लोमश्य, अम्, n. hairiness, woolliness; rough-
ness; N. of a particular pronunciation of the sibi-
lants (Ved.).
लोमाशिका, f. the female of the jackal or fox.
